reviews.body:
Hey, thanks for the contribution! The only problem I see is for clusters that have already hit #867. 

Because validateCRD runs on every update, Kratix's own updates to the duplicate Promise get rejected, including the finalizer removals during deletion. So we couldn't clean up by deleting the duplicate, and it would stay stuck in Terminating. 

Could you run the ownership check only on create, and on update only when the old Promise had no API (the one way an update can claim a new CRD)? Please also add a test showing that an update to a Promise that doesn't own the CRD is still admitted.
